description:
Submit a publisher's sites and prices to WeCookFlow — for site owners and resellers who sell guest posts.

    Only with the user's consent. A person reviews the application and replies by email; prices are not published
    automatically. Same as the form at wecookflow.com/publishers.

currency.description: USD (default), EUR, GBP, INR or RUB.
currency.title: Currency

niche_prices.description: Prices for special niches if different, keys: casino (or igaming), crypto, cbd, adult. Other niches — in note.
niche_prices.title: Niche Prices

note.description: Anything else about this site (turnaround, restrictions).
note.title: Note

price.description: Price for one placement of this type.
price.title: Price

type.description: guest_post (new article) or link_insertion (link in an existing article).
type.title: Type

email.description: The publisher's email for the reply — ask the user, never invent one.
email.title: Email

messenger.description: Telegram or WhatsApp contact, if the user wants.
messenger.title: Messenger

payment.description: Accepted payment methods: USDT, PayPal, Wise, Bank transfer (others as text).
payment.title: Payment

role.description: owner — owns the sites; reseller — sells others' sites; agency.
role.title: Role

sheet_url.description: Link to the price list (e.g. a Google Sheet).
sheet_url.title: Sheet Url

sites.description: Sites with prices, up to 1,000 per call. Send sites, sheet_url or both.
sites.title: Sites

terms.description: General terms: turnaround, content rules, link lifetime.
terms.title: Terms

name: submit_sites
title: Submit sites for sale
